title: From Laredo roots to a major label: Austin's Sana Sana Música signs with Republic Records
excerpt: An Austin-based, cumbia-infused Latin band with two Laredoans in its ranks has signed with Republic Records. Sana Sana Música — the trio of frontwoman Sisi, guitarist-bassist Maximiliano and Grammy-winning producer Joseph — just released its debut single "Hay Que Volver" through Republic Records and Universal Music Latino.
content:
Another border-city dream just got a national stage. Sana Sana Música, an Austin-based Latin and cumbia-infused band that includes two Laredoans, has signed with Republic Records, according to KGNS (Oct. 20, 2026).

The trio brings together Venezuelan-American frontwoman Sisi, guitarist and bassist Maximiliano — described as a proud Texas-Mexico border native — and Grammy Award-winning producer Joseph, according to the band's label announcement (Imprint Entertainment, Oct. 2026).

The signing comes with music already out in the world. The band has released its debut single and official music video, "Hay Que Volver" — roughly, "We Have to Return" — through Republic Records and Universal Music Latino. The track weaves smoky drums and chopped-up Spanish soul samples into a simmering groove, with blues-tinged guitar and bright keys under Sisi's smoldering vocal.

Sisi has described the song as a reflection of the most prevalent feeling of her life: the pull of finding a way back home — to family, to roots, to oneself, to one's country — and to the certainty that going back is in our blood.

The sound is a borderland blend by design: Latin rhythms and American rock and soul refracted through the members' Venezuelan heritage and Texas border-town influences, emerging from Austin's music scene.

For Laredo listeners, the local tie makes it personal. A band carrying border roots onto a major label roster is exactly the kind of hometown story Webb Watch loves to follow — and we'll be listening for what comes next.

Sources: KGNS (kgns.tv), "Laredo-rooted band Sana Sana signs with Republic Records" (Oct. 20, 2026); Imprint Entertainment, "Emerging Latin Band Sana Sana Música Release Debut Single & Music Video 'Hay Que Volver'" (Oct. 2026).
